lines: You got into a European university?
An apostille or legalization on your documents.
Certified translations, often by a sworn translator.
Proof that you can pay for your stay.
A residence permit — often filed at an embassy before you travel. It can take weeks or months.
And registration after you arrive — within days in many countries.
Miss one deadline, and it can cost you a whole year.
DocRoute puts it all in one route: in the right order, with deadlines, and an official source for every step.
